# Transnoise VST3 plugin (JUCE, used under the AGPLv3). Build it on Windows with build_win.bat.
#   Depends on ../cpp/include (the model core, zero dependencies) and ../cpp/gen/{config.h,weights.bin} (generated by deploy.pack; weights.bin is compiled into the plugin)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(Transnoise VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(TN_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../cpp" CACHE PATH "Model core directory (containing include/ and gen/)")

include(FetchContent)
# Use a source archive instead of git clone: the project directory lives on the WSL filesystem, and Windows git refuses to operate in it because the file owner differs (dubious ownership)
FetchContent_Declare(juce
  URL https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/archive/refs/tags/8.0.17-security.zip
  DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(juce)

juce_add_plugin(Transnoise
  COMPANY_NAME "Morindill"
  IS_SYNTH FALSE
  NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
  NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
  PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Mrnd
  PLUGIN_CODE Trns
  FORMATS VST3 Standalone
  VST3_CATEGORIES Fx
  PRODUCT_NAME "Transnoise"
  COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE)

# Compile the weights into the plugin (BinaryData::weights_bin)
juce_add_binary_data(TnWeights SOURCES "${TN_ROOT}/gen/weights.bin")

target_sources(Transnoise PRIVATE Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginProcessor.h)
target_include_directories(Transnoise PRIVATE "${TN_ROOT}/include" "${TN_ROOT}/gen")
target_compile_definitions(Transnoise PUBLIC JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 JUCE_USE_CURL=0 JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0)
target_link_libraries(Transnoise
  PRIVATE TnWeights juce::juce_audio_utils
  PUBLIC juce::juce_recommended_config_flags juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

# The model core's matrix-vector products rely on compiler auto-vectorization; the default is SSE2 only, AVX2 is about twice as fast (needs a CPU from 2013 or later)
# /utf-8: the sources are UTF-8 (runtime messages contain Chinese); MSVC on a Chinese-locale system reads them as GBK (936) by default, which can swallow newlines/quotes after Chinese characters
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(Transnoise PRIVATE /arch:AVX2 /utf-8)
endif()
